data.subject: A familiar interface leaves room for the work
data.body:
A subject gives someone enough information to decide whether to open a conversation. A preview offers a little more. The rest can wait until they are interested.

An inbox gives projects and writing their own space without putting every explanation on the first screen. Familiar controls also leave less interface to explain.

This is sample writing. You can replace it in assets/data/writing.json.
